messages:
zoe: quick FYI - night ingest run exposed heavy_eval backlog causing timeouts. repro: `./bench/smoke --clients 120 --tail-seq`. snippet: `validator: stage=heavy_eval error=deadline_exceeded`. anyone seen similar?
mark: on shared runners? config?
zoe: yes shared. ingest.max=10, bench.window=45s. large batches + kv warmup = tail.
anya: we should decouple admit vs final-validate. two options: synchronous full-validate (current) or provisional admit + async deep-bench.
ravi: +1 provisional, but add a tiny sync golden-check (1-3 samples) to avoid obvious regressions slipping by. API will need to return provisional token and final callback.
mark: agree on guard rails: if heavy_eval.backlog > limit return explicit `reject:bench_saturated` rather than enqueuing.
zoe: implementation notes: need admit-store TTL and tombstone cleanup. also telemetry: `admit.provisional_total`, `admit.final_latency_p95`, `bench.reject_rate`.
infra-bot: Note: infra deploy freeze 00:00-06:00 UTC.
anya: i'll draft an RFC addendum with sequence diagrams and payload examples. assign to me, target PR by Tue.
mark: I'll review perf impact once draft lands.
zoe: thanks, will post in #eng-ml-rfcs when ready.
__meta: generated for dataset: slack thread about onboarding pipeline provisional admits, tiny golden-checks, and saturation guards
